Override.entitydescription.mudraptorshell: A protective shell of a mudraptor. You can use a fabricator to change its appearance.
Override.entitydescription.machinepistol: A high rate of fire automatic weapon, using .45 (SMG) caliber magazines or pistol magazines. Hard to aim. Can be modified at a fabricator

infotexts.entitydescription.militarybackpack: Backpack with a large inventory, waterproof, but slows down user's speed.
infotexts.entitydescription.beltpack: Can carry more stuff than a toolbelt.
infotexts.entitydescription.EMSpack: Bag for emergency medical service, can improve user's medical skill.
infotexts.entitydescription.Toolkit: Handy beltbag, can improve user's mechanic and electronical skills.
infotexts.entitydescription.duffelpack: A patched duffel bag, can carry ammo boxes. Besides, you'd better have taken good care of this unlucky guy's belongings.
infotexts.entitydescription.rigging: A portable tool kit for storing small items. Equipped in outer clothes slot.
infotexts.entitydescription.chiyuan: Cover Vest designed to perform assaults. Can carry some supplies.
infotexts.entitydescription.antirain: The shining beacon of a brave new world.
infotexts.entitydescription.vector2: "So can we drink the cocktail, I mean, drink molotov?"
infotexts.entitydescription.borderline: Defend every inch of territorial waters.
infotexts.entitydescription.defy: "True freedom is possessing the right to defy, yet choosing loyalty."
infotexts.entitydescription.JS9_uniform: "What do you mean to take care of a warehouse in the intelligence service?"
infotexts.entitydescription.GKuniform: Standard uniform of a private military contractor. Durable enough to be worn from your first day on the job until the day the water pressure crushes you.
infotexts.entitydescription.beret: "Shiki kan, it's enough to have me here..."
infotexts.entitydescription.exoskeleton_light: Enhances user's mobility and striking strength while providing protection. Needs battery.
infotexts.entitydescription.exoskeleton_standard: An exoskeleton that focuses on its protection ability. Needs battery.
infotexts.entitydescription.iop_armorvest: A set of seemingly retro ballistic equipment that's nonetheless quite effective. Perfectly functional aside from being somewhat heavy.
infotexts.entitydescription.the_jupiter: "She has witnessed too many wars with no anthems, and heroes with no graves."
infotexts.entitydescription.the_jupiter_collapse_l: Pure Collapse Liquid, an essential material for crafting The Mark of Vengeance. \n A major leak of Collapse Liquid caused significant casualties and property damage during the Beilan Island Incident. Despite years having passed, the entire event remains shrouded in mystery. \n "A radioactive substance discovered in the Beilan Island ruins, capable of self-replication under specific catalytic conditions. Believed to be a relic of a prior civilization on Europa." — Beilan Island Ruins Research Report

A fluorescent green radioactive liquid that feels unsettling just to look at. Two vials of the same concentration of Collapse Liquid can be purified into one vial of higher concentration at a research station. \n "Hey! Close the lid now!" — A researcher's last words

A fluorescent green radioactive liquid. Any leakage would have catastrophic consequences. Two vials of the same concentration of Collapse Liquid can be purified into one vial of higher concentration at a research station. \n "January 17, 2030, 15:17 - A massive explosion occurred at the Beilan Island ruins, causing a major leakage of Collapse Liquid." — Beilan Island Incident
infotexts.entitydescription.the_jupiter_buleprint: The blueprint of The Mark of Vengeance, successfully weaponized collapse liquid.
infotexts.entitydescription.Kaltsituniform: "Even if you turn to ashes, I can still pull you back!"
infotexts.entitydescription.penguin_logistics: "Any methods can be taken to achieve your goals."
infotexts.entitydescription.RodesResearcherUniform: "Generally speaking, men do more harm than natural disasters."
infotexts.entitydescription.AbyssalHunterHat: "... Let's go hunt down some behemoths."
infotexts.entitydescription.doctorsuniform3: The bright color brings everyone's attention to you... also those in need of course.
infotexts.entitydescription.bulletproofsuit: "This suit never goona give you up." — John Rick
infotexts.entitydescription.lightarmor: A lightweight combat suit with advanced technology, can provide its user with weapon skill bonuses and protection.\n This is still working in progress. How did you get this stuff?
infotexts.entitydescription.edgerunner: "Quiet life or a blaze of glory?"
infotexts.entitydescription.firmament: Helmet able to carry two equipment, can inject medicine when wearer's healthy situation gets worse. Has white and black versions.
infotexts.entitydescription.firmament_b: Helmet able to carry two equipment, can inject medicine when wearer's healthy situation gets worse. Has white and black versions.
infotexts.entitydescription.clowndivingmask_alt: (Wearing position is different) A clown mask combined with a diving mask, allowing the user to both clown around and breathe underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.maidclothes1: "... That should cost you another fee."
infotexts.entitydescription.bastard_sword: A milestone in human melee weapon history. But is it still useful on Europa?
infotexts.entitydescription.bastard_sword_kai: A modernized bastard sword enhanced with alien materials, capable of slicing through almost any creature's armor. However, the intense heat seals wounds instantly, eliminating its ability to cause bleeding.
infotexts.entitydescription.mosquito_swatter: No mosquitoes here, but perhaps it could be used as a defibrillator if you crank up the voltage?
infotexts.entitydescription.masksmanrifle: Designed assault rifle. Slower firing rate with higher accuracy and damage.
infotexts.entitydescription.coilrifle: Fire bullet by coil acceleration. Capable of firing harpoons too.
infotexts.entitydescription.smallriotshield: One-handed small riotshield. You can use it with a sidearm.
infotexts.entitydescription.machinepistol_plus: A high rate of fire automatic weapon, using .45 (SMG) caliber magazines or pistol magazines. More accurate and deadly after the modification.
infotexts.entitydescription.ceremonialsword_heavy: A well decorated great sword, requires skills to wield it.
infotexts.entitydescription.expendable_rocket_laun: A single-shot rocket launcher (E.H.E.), firing high-explosive ordnance effective against most targets.
Already spent. Now it's just an empty steel tube.
infotexts.entitydescription.magnum: Fires .50 caliber rounds, integrated with an independent sighting system. A real powerhouse in the right hands. \n"Caliber is justice!"
infotexts.entitydescription.magnum_magazine: Contains eight .50 caliber rounds in total, each perfectly suited for putting a hole in an enemy.
infotexts.entitydescription.leverrifle: A classic that will always have its fans. If your rate of fire is high enough, accuracy shouldn't be your primary concern.
infotexts.entitydescription.grenadelauncher_portab: "A rifle with blanks can launch grenades just fine. Why bother making this?"\n"'Cause I feel like it!"
infotexts.entitydescription.utility_knife: An oversized "cutting tool" that can be used to deal with individuals you dislike. Requires a blade to be mounted for use. Due to the rigid connection between the blade and handle, forcibly removing the blade will damage it.
infotexts.entitydescription.utility_knife_blade_st: A steel blade of "Utility Knife". Durability is abandoned in exchange for sharpness. It has a thin blade and is used as a consumable.
infotexts.entitydescription.utility_knife_blade_ti: A titanium-aluminum alloy blade of "Utility Knife" is much sharper and stronger than the steel one, but it is still fragile, so use it as a durable consumable.
infotexts.entitydescription.utility_knife_blade_ph: A physicorium blade of "Utility Knife". Physicorium is somehow thinned into a blade. It is indeed very durable, but it is still a consumable.
infotexts.entitydescription.EAHI_autoinjectorheads: The integrated self-injection earphone developed by East Asia Heavy Industries has a health scanner function and a built-in authority simulation system that can crack most alliance insurance.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_pucs: Utilizes experimental technology to replace the heavy shell of a diving suit with a pressure stabilizer, offering better visibility and maneuverability compared to a regular PUCS. The maximum available depth is 6000 meters.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_pucs_R: A targeted improvement of the EPSP, reinforced with bulletproof fibers to enhance defense against certain attacks. The maximum available depth is 6200 meters.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_pucs_B: A targeted improvement of the EPSP, reinforced with bulletproof fibers and titanium-aluminum alloy to enhance defense. It maintains excellent burn protection while offering the defense and a better pressure resistance of standard abyssal diving suits. The maximum available depth is 8000 meters.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_pucs_D: A targeted improvement of the EPSP, equipped with intelligent assistance systems to help personnel perform better technical tasks. The maximum available depth is 6200 meters.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_pucs_S: A targeted improvement of the EPSP. With scooters it can help personnel move better underwater. The maximum available depth is 6200 meters.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_pucs_I: This special EPSP uses alien circuits to make its appearance transparent. The maximum available depth is 6000 meters.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_New_XDS-01: An experimental diving suit made of unidentified cyborg body found in the deep sea. It has better performance than any diving suit circulating on Europa
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_New_XDS-01_Engine: An experimental diving suit components made of unidentified cyborg body found in the deep sea, divers' swimming speed can be greatly increased after being powering on. The principle is unknown
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_debris: Biomechanical remains discovered in the deep sea, showing striking resemblance to a human female. Perhaps it could be repurposed into a diving suit.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_Research_Box: A safe discovered in the deep sea. A faint Union insignia can be seen in a hidden spot.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_Research_chip: A fragment chip containing part of the XDS01 blueprint, found in a Union safe. Designed to self-erase the accessed portion upon reading.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_Research_Log: A research log for the XDS01 discovered in a Union safe. The contents are corrupted and unreadable, but the Union might pay a high price to retrieve it.
infotexts.entitydescription.ironpipe: An ordinary steel pipe, perhaps with alternative uses? \n "Give me a fulcrum, and I shall move Europa."
infotexts.entitydescription.wf_vodka: "This is the best thing under this sea, my comrade."
infotexts.entitydescription.bat: A steel baseball bat, it is said to have sold more than baseballs on Earth.
infotexts.entitydescription.tankcontainer: Can carry four tanks at once.
infotexts.entitydescription.scope: A traditional long-range optical sight that expands the shooter's field of view.
infotexts.entitydescription.reddot: A compact sight compatible with most weapons, improving aiming accuracy.
infotexts.entitydescription.hybridscope: An advanced optical sight combining red dot and rifle scope functionalities with moderate magnification.
infotexts.entitydescription.wf_laserpointer: Weapon attachment for indicating aiming direction, increases accuracy. Requires battery.
infotexts.entitydescription.coilrifle_blueprint: Item fabrication blueprint. Read it to permanently unlock the recipe for the Coilrifle and Coilrifle Magazine.
infotexts.entitydescription.utility_knife_blueprin: Item fabrication blueprint. Read it to permanently unlock the recipe for the "Utility Knife" and its compatible blades.
infotexts.entitydescription.EAHI_autoinjectorheads: Item fabrication blueprint. Read it to permanently unlock the recipe for [EA-HI] Self-injecting earphones.
infotexts.entitydescription.expendable_rocket_laun: Item fabrication blueprint. Read it to permanently unlock the recipe for Expendable Rocket Launcher.
infotexts.entitydescription.EPSPs_blueprint: Item fabrication blueprint. Read it to permanently unlock the recipe for EPSP diving suits.
infotexts.entitydescription.leverrifle_blueprint: Item fabrication blueprint. Read it to permanently unlock the recipe for Lever-action Rifle.
infotexts.entitydescription.magnum_blueprint: Item fabrication blueprint. Read it to permanently unlock the recipe for Magnum Pistol.
infotexts.entitydescription.smgunique_blueprint: Item fabrication blueprint. Read it to permanently unlock the recipe for Deadeye Carbine.
infotexts.entitydescription.shotgununique_blueprin: Item fabrication blueprint. Read it to permanently unlock the recipe for Boom Stick.
infotexts.entitydescription.grenadelauncher_portab: Item fabrication blueprint. Read it to permanently unlock the recipe for Portable Grenade Launcher.
infotexts.entitydescription.captainscap1_enhanced: A veteran's cap reinforced with ballistic fibers, offering protection comparable to a helmet. \n"Europa technology, truly formidable."
infotexts.entitydescription.captainscap2_enhanced: A renegade's hat reinforced with ballistic fibers, offering protection comparable to a helmet. \n"Europa technology, truly formidable."
infotexts.entitydescription.captainscap3_enhanced: An admiral's hat reinforced with ballistic fibers, offering protection comparable to a helmet. \n"Europa technology, truly formidable."
infotexts.entitydescription.captainsseparatistcap1: A veteran's hat reinforced with ballistic fibers, offering protection comparable to a helmet. \n"Europa technology, truly formidable."
infotexts.entitydescription.captainsseparatistcap2: A warlord's hat reinforced with ballistic fibers, offering protection comparable to a helmet. \n"Europa technology, truly formidable."
infotexts.entitydescription.piratecaptainhat_enhan: A separatist captain hat reinforced with ballistic fibers, offering protection comparable to a helmet. \n"Europa technology, truly formidable."
infotexts.entitydescription.baseballcap_enhanced: A baseball cap reinforced with ballistic fibers, offering protection comparable to a helmet. \n"Europa technology, truly formidable."
infotexts.entitydescription.AbyssalHunterHat_enhan: An Abyssal Hunter's hat reinforced with ballistic fibers, offering protection comparable to a helmet. \n"Europa technology, truly formidable."
infotexts.entitydescription.beret_enhanced: A beret reinforced with ballistic fibers, offering protection comparable to a helmet. \n"Europa technology, truly formidable."
infotexts.entitydescription.piratebandana_enhanced: A separatist Bandana reinforced with ballistic fibers, offering protection comparable to a helmet. \n"Europa technology, truly formidable."
infotexts.entitydescription.cultistheadgear_enhanc: A cultist headdress reinforced with ballistic fibers, offering protection comparable to a helmet. \n"Europa technology, truly formidable."
infotexts.entitydescription.404uniform_old: An old-style uniform that appears to have seen better days.
infotexts.entitydescription.antirain_old: An old-style uniform, more simplistic compared to the current version.
infotexts.entitydescription.HeiTieuniform_old: An old-style uniform from Blacksteel. Still quite practical.
infotexts.entitydescription.researcherclothes_old: It's said that this was designed in a swimsuit style for convenience during underwater research, though it's still unclear why it was only issued to female researchers at the time.
infotexts.entitydescription.securityuniform2_old: An old-style uniform. It still carries a faint scent of sweat.
infotexts.entitydescription.penguin_logistics_old: A uniform that once belonged to a employee, now showing considerable wear and tear.
infotexts.EventText.missionevent_EAHI1.c1: Loafer[EA-HI liaison officer]: Zzz. This is your commision, don't disturb my sleep.
infotexts.EventText.missionevent_EAHI2.c1: Chao Wendao [EA-HI Delegate]: Are you here to accept the entrustment? OK, there are two tasks here.
infotexts.EventText.missionevent_XML.c1: The liaison said that recently a group of particularly ferocious mudraptor was attacking ships traveling in the waterway, seriously affecting the interests of the company. [reward]mk has been promised to those who annihilate this horde of monsters. "
infotexts.EventText.missionevent_PP.c1: Several Crawler Mothers leads hordes of crawlers to attack ships in the waterway. The East Asia Heavy Industries promises to give [reward]mk rewards to those who annihilate this group of monsters.
infotexts.EventText.missionevent_HF.c1: A large number of golden hammerheads are entrenched in the waterway, seriously affecting the transportation of people and goods. East Asia Heavy Industries is offering a reward [reward]mk to all captains in order to solve this problem.
infotexts.EventText.missionevent_MLK.c1: "A horde of aggressive molochs are attacking ships traveling between [location1] and [location2]. A [reward]mk has been promised to whoever annihilates the horde."
infotexts.EventText.missionevent_SY.c1: EA-Hi's illegal experiment in the abyss alarmed the Destruction Worm. The liaison officer hopes that you can defeat the Worm before it is discovered by the coalition, otherwise the EA-HI will face a large fine.
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_YMLKR: The EA-HI recently ordered a large amount of tobacco, but due to the coalition's embargo on strategic materials, it could not be delivered, and the site was checking for contraband. In order to prevent exposure, the liaison officer asked you to help deliver a batch of goods. "Wait, when did tobacco become illegal?"
infotexts.missionfailure.EAHI_Mission_YMLKR: Obviously, these are not tobacco at all, but Mutated Pomegrenades
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_FXGB: 【Warn! High-risk] The liaison officer entrusted you to deliver a batch of high-risk Volatile Fulgurium Fuel Rods, and gave [reward]mk, you think about it, it is nothing more than radiation sickness. "How can my life be more important than money?"
infotexts.missionsuccess.EAHI_mission_FXGB: Volatile Fulgurium Fuel Rods have been successfully delivered to [location2]
infotexts.missionfailure.EAHI_mission_FXGB: Dude, you need to be alive to spend your money.
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_ZBKC: 【warn! High-risk] The liaison officer entrusted you to deliver a batch of high-risk Volatile Compound Ns, and gave [reward] mk. 【You must deliver them within 10 minutes, otherwise the consequences will be at your own risk】
infotexts.missionsuccess.EAHI_mission_ZBKC: You breathe a sigh of relief that the Volatile Compound Ns has been successfully delivered to [location2].
infotexts.missionfailure.EAHI_Mission_ZBKC: Dude, you need to be alive to spend your money.
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_YYWH_1: The liaison officer has tasked you with transporting a batch of medals and has given you [reward]mk. "I hope you don't use them yourself," the liaison officer says, "though there's nothing I can do if you do."
infotexts.missionsuccess.EAHI_mission_YYWH_1: You amazingly managed to resist your greed.
infotexts.missionfailure.EAHI_mission_YYWH_1: "I knew it," said the liaison officer.
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_YYWH_2: The liaison officer has tasked you with transporting a batch of Endocrine Boosters and has given you [reward]mk. "I hope you don't use them yourself," the liaison officer says, "though there's nothing I can do if you do."
infotexts.missionsuccess.EAHI_mission_YYWH_2: You amazingly managed to resist your greed.
infotexts.missionfailure.EAHI_mission_YYWH_2: "I knew it," said the liaison officer.
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_YYWH_3: The liaison officer has tasked you with transporting a batch of skill books and has given you [reward]mk. "I hope you don't use them yourself," the liaison officer says, "though there's nothing I can do if you do."
infotexts.missionsuccess.EAHI_mission_YYWH_3: You amazingly managed to resist your greed.
infotexts.missionfailure.EAHI_mission_YYWH_3: "I knew it," said the liaison officer.
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_LJC: The liaison entrusts you to deliver a batch of scraps with rewards of [reward]mk
infotexts.missionsuccess.EAHI_mission_LJC: Scraps have been successfully delivered to [location2]
infotexts.missionfailure.EAHI_mission_LJC: No way, why would someone steal scraps?
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_FZ: The liaison entrusts you to deliver a batch of clothese with rewards of [reward]mk
infotexts.missionsuccess.EAHI_mission_FZ: All Clothings have been successfully delivered to [location2]
infotexts.missionfailure.EAHI_mission_FZ: No way, why would someone steal clothes?
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_XDY: Given Europa's terrible network environment, the liaison officer asks you to help him transport a batch of goods, mainly hard drives. "They're all confidential files, don't snoop around," the liaison officer says. The company will offer you [reward]mk
infotexts.missionsuccess.EAHI_mission_XDY: You skimmed through the logs but didn't find what you were looking for. Anyway, the stuff is delivered, so who cares.
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_PPQY: East Asia Heavy Industries entrusts you to assassinate a senior official of the alliance who hinders the company's interests. If you succeed, you will be given [reward]mk. Please bide your time, clear them all, and throw the bodies overboard.
infotexts.missionsuccess.EAHI_mission_PPQY: "It's not surprising what happens in the deep sea, is it?"
infotexts.missionfailure.EAHI_Mission_PPQY: You killed the senior officer at the wrong time, allowing him to send a distress message
infotexts.missionmessage0.EAHI_mission_PPQY: You killed the senior officer at the wrong time, allowing him to send a distress message
infotexts.missionmessage1.EAHI_mission_PPQY: You got your timing and killed the top officer in the comms blind spot
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_PP: Several Crawler Mothers lead hordes of Creepers to attack ships in the channel. East Asia Heavy Industries promised to give [reward] mk rewards to those who wiped out this group of monsters.
infotexts.missionfailure.EAHI_mission_PP: You failed to kill all the crawlers
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_XML: The liaison officer said that recently a group of particularly ferocious Mudraptors were attacking ships traveling in the waterway, seriously affecting the interests of the company. A reward of [reward] mk] has been promised to whoever annihilates this horde of monsters.
infotexts.missionfailure.EAHI_mission_XML: You failed to kill all the Mudraptors
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_HF: A large number of golden hammerheads are entrenched in the waterway, seriously affecting the transportation of people and goods. East Asia Heavy Industries is offering a reward of [reward] mk to all free captains in order to solve this problem.
infotexts.missionfailure.EAHI_Mission_HF: The golden storm is still raging.
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_MLKQ: A group of extremely powerful molochs are attacking the ships traveling in the channel. A reward of [reward]mk has been promised to those who annihilate this group of monsters.
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_HMLK: A group of extremely aggressive black molochs are attacking the ships traveling in the channel. A reward of [reward]mk has been promised to those who annihilate this group of monsters.
infotexts.missionsuccess.EAHI_mission_HMLK: The black moloch group has been cleared
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_XFFSY_1: EA-HI's illegal experiment in the abyss alarmed the Doomworm. The liaison officer hopes that you can defeat the Worm before it is discovered by the Alliance, otherwise East Asia Heavy Industries will face a large fine.
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_XFFSY_2: EA-Hi's illegal experiment in the abyss alarmed the Charybdis, and the liaison officer hopes that you can defeat the Charybdis before it is discovered by the alliance, otherwise East Asia Heavy Industries will face a large fine.
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_XFFSY_3: EA-HI's illegal experiment in the abyss has alarmed the Endworm. The liaison officer hopes that you can defeat the worm before it is discovered by the alliance, otherwise Dongya Heavy Industries will face a large fine.
infotexts.missiondescription.EAHI_mission_JGHX: The Liaison officer invites you to a good show, the showdown of the century between Hammerhead and the Charybdis. "Remember to remain silent," said the liaison officer.
infotexts.missionsuccess.EAHI_mission_JGHX: It was brilliant, it's a pity someone has to clean up the mess.
infotexts.missionfailure.EAHI_Mission_JGHX: You failed to keep silent and got caught up in the fray
infotexts.missionmessage0.EAHI_mission_XML: The Mudraptor has been cleared. Return to the station to claim your reward.
infotexts.missionmessage0.EAHI_mission_PP: The Algae Crawlers have been cleared. Return to the station to claim your reward.
infotexts.missionmessage0.EAHI_mission_HF: The Golden Storm has dispersed. Return to the station to claim your reward.
infotexts.missionmessage0.EAHI_mission_MLKQ: The Moloch group has been cleared. Return to the station to claim your reward.
infotexts.missionmessage0.EAHI_mission_HMLK: The Moloch group has been cleared. Return to the station to claim your reward.
infotexts.missionmessage0.EAHI_mission_XFFSY_2: You watch the massive body of the Charybdis die. You wonder why something so ugly is called a Siren.
infotexts.missionmessage0.EAHI_mission_XFFSY_3: You watch the massive body of the Endworm sink into the abyss, and breathe a sigh of relief.
infotexts.missionmessage0.EAHI_mission_JGHX: Quite a show, but someone has to clean up the mess.
